disclaimer: Roles, response windows and gates are calibration hypotheses, not assigned government duties, contracts, budgets or current service standards.

consulted: affected users before any real trial

sc04_minimum_pilot.always_on_non_ai_path: printed service directory plus staffed referral script

tabletop_rehearsal.bounded_claim: local synthetic state, queue, stop, deletion and rollback logic only; no real system, participant, service performance or field acceptance
tabletop_rehearsal.operational_effect: none; G2 remains blocked and G3 operational sandbox remains not run

gates.name: problem_and_place
gates.advance_when: official candidate place, title, accessibility and service boundary are field-checked

gates.name: data_and_permissions
gates.advance_when: authorized data role confirms classification, retention, deletion, logging and isolation
gates.fail_to: permissions disabled; manual expected-queue comparison only

gates.name: human_duty_and_fallback
gates.advance_when: one accountable role, duty roster, escalation contact, takeover drill and accessibility walk-through are confirmed
gates.fail_to: no operational sandbox or limited trial

gates.name: sandbox_test
gates.advance_when: after G2, an authorized operational sandbox passes all six criteria with complete evidence
gates.fail_to: stop, isolate and execute rollback actions

gates.name: adopt_reject_retest
gates.advance_when: authorized human signs evidence and decision diff
gates.fail_to: reject, pause or require retest; never auto-launch

gates.name: bounded_trial
gates.advance_when: operator, place, permissions, data necessity, insurance, appeal, maintenance and cost gates all pass

gates.name: rollback_or_retirement
gates.advance_when: shutdown, isolation, human fallback, log disposition and exit record have completion evidence
gates.fail_to: no restart; new receipt begins at G0

regional_interfaces.name: 北纬社区

regional_interfaces.input: edge model, embodied device and test-method directions
regional_interfaces.output: model cards, device passports, failure manifests
regional_interfaces.gate: responsibility, IP and safety scope confirmed; no automatic result recognition

regional_interfaces.name: 怀柔科学城
regional_interfaces.gate: data licence and professional responsibility confirmed

regional_interfaces.name: 经开区
regional_interfaces.gate: voluntary participation and consumer-rights review; no purchase commitment

regional_interfaces.name: 京津冀
regional_interfaces.input: cross-city common problems and protocol reuse
regional_interfaces.output: de-located schemas, negative results and version diffs
regional_interfaces.gate: independent local legal review; no transfer of personal or precise local data

action_packages.gate: continuous non-AI route audited for every pilot segment
action_packages.stop: isolate any serious safety gap; do not expand without a disposition path

action_packages.gate: emergency stop, permission isolation, failure record and retest rule complete
action_packages.stop: stop immediately on severe risk or failed human takeover

action_packages.gate: source, licence, boundary and next owner recorded
action_packages.stop: pause distribution on unresolved rights or safety dispute

action_packages.gate: ground-level ordinary route and human desk work before AI enhancement
action_packages.stop: disable enhancement on safety conflict or unavailable human channel

action_packages.gate: input, output, licence, expiry and exit owner recorded
action_packages.stop: do not publish an unconfirmed participant or unverifiable capability

action_packages.gate: positive and negative results, human diff, deletion and rollback traceable
action_packages.stop: pause the scenario on overdue deletion or appeal

action_packages.gate: source, permission, dispute and withdrawal route present for every display
action_packages.stop: hide first on rights dispute; restore only after human verification

action_packages.gate: continue, adjust and stop decisions all published
action_packages.stop: scale down or cancel if owner, permission, recurring budget, duty roster or exit plan is missing
